Streaming responses

Use the stream() context manager to read a response incrementally. Each chunk is bounded, so memory use stays flat.

Iterating bytes

  • Call iter_bytes() for raw chunks.
  • Call iter_text() for decoded text.
with client.stream("GET", url) as response:
    for chunk in response.iter_bytes():
        handle(chunk)
